title: Vintage Enzo Mari Cast Iron Dutch Oven Size 29 – Grey Enamel – Made in France – Designer Cookware
description:
Beautiful vintage enameled cast iron Dutch oven, size 29, designed by renowned Italian designer Enzo Mari and made in France. This piece combines high-quality French cast iron craftsmanship with iconic Italian modernist design.
The pot features a minimalist grey enamel exterior with a cream interior, a matching lid with knob, and two side handles for easy handling. The heavy cast iron ensures excellent heat retention and even cooking, making it ideal for stews, braising, soups, roasting, and slow cooking.
Designs by Enzo Mari are highly appreciated by design collectors and mid-century modern enthusiasts.
Details:
• Designer: Enzo Mari
• Type: Cast iron Dutch oven / casserole
• Size: 29
• Material: Enameled cast iron
• Color: Grey exterior, cream interior
• Made in France
• Includes matching lid
• Two side handles
Condition:
Good vintage condition with normal signs of use consistent with age. The enamel remains solid and functional. Please see photos for full condition details.
A beautiful piece of vintage designer cookware, perfect for both daily cooking and collectors of modernist kitchen design.
